## Package

## Install

```sh
opencode plugin @mirrowel/opencode-openshare@dev --global
```

## Scope

**Parts changed:** plugin worker
**npm: published as @mirrowel/opencode-openshare@0.3.0-dev.17**

## What's Changed

### Fixes
- fix(plugin): 🐛 manual-mode detection missed tui.json on case-sensitive fs ([`95d6dcc`](https://github.com/Mirrowel/openshare/commit/95d6dcce7646c571a5e7c71f2a2d91a2be54f15a)) by @Mirrowel
- fix(tests): 🐛 first CI run of the suites could not pass anywhere ([`73a9c41`](https://github.com/Mirrowel/openshare/commit/73a9c410bca45da97de0af8eb062c4ea1d4f29ed)) by @Mirrowel
- fix(ci): 🐛 smoke step hung after a successful boot ([`6c6bf0c`](https://github.com/Mirrowel/openshare/commit/6c6bf0cd9008d2c4c759b98862a35ed3aa963ce9)) by @Mirrowel
- fix(ci): 🐛 workerd cannot start on ubuntu-24.04 runners without userns ([`2e49345`](https://github.com/Mirrowel/openshare/commit/2e4934575389095c960afffeae5707fbbb05d767)) by @Mirrowel
- fix(tests): 🐛 shared-worker boot slides on runner port conflicts ([`e943fd3`](https://github.com/Mirrowel/openshare/commit/e943fd384239937e67fa96aee8c337a6351c5ac2)) by @Mirrowel
- fix(tests): 🐛 slide the matrix port block when the runner holds a port ([`8d6b939`](https://github.com/Mirrowel/openshare/commit/8d6b93970d73074ae1f98f3bd36bf698d0a3bc51)) by @Mirrowel

### Maintenance
- chore(ci): 🧹 rebuild the standalone bundle for the case-preserving walk ([`fdf2d4c`](https://github.com/Mirrowel/openshare/commit/fdf2d4cb446a2955ddd0f9846b4aafcf533ac373)) by @Mirrowel
